title: run.skill.md Phase 3 patch_file guidance conflicts with no-preferred-patch-file rubric
description: run.skill.md Phase 3 still instructs agents to use patch_file for changes fewer than ~20 lines. The new no-preferred-patch-file rubric criterion evaluates whether files written during a run instruct agents to prefer patch_file. A future run agent that reads run.skill.md and uses the no-preferred-patch-file criterion will encounter a self-referential tension: the file it operates under (run.skill.md) itself contains a patch_file preference instruction. This spec intentionally left Phase 3 unchanged, but the rubric criterion as written may flag run.skill.md as a violation in future runs.
proposed_resolution: Either: (a) remove the patch_file preference guidance from run.skill.md Phase 3 in a follow-up spec, replacing it with unconditional write_file; or (b) narrow the no-preferred-patch-file rubric criterion to apply only to 'files written or created during this run' (not pre-existing skill files), which is already the stated intent but may need clarification.
